thread:
sami: quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: API / Console / Optimize timelines — collecting definitive answers for customer comms.

olga: can you confirm which features are beta vs canary vs GA for this quarter?

sami: short: Beta (Console: suggestions UI + template import) = early Q3; Canary (Optimize recommender + one-click apply) = mid Q3 at 10% traffic; GA hosted late Q3. Dedicated/private stagger into Q4.

ben: what about SLAs and limits we should publish? customers asked specifically.

sami: hosted GA will carry standard platform SLOs; Optimize suggestions will have a 99.9% availability target for suggestion retrieval. we'll publish per-route rate limits in the beta notes.

terry: compatibility matrix for models/quant? need copy for docs.

olga: initial support: decoder-only transformer models FP16 and INT8. 4-bit/experimental quant shown as "experimental" in UI and opt-in only. suggestions will include compatibility tags.

ben: rollback criteria during canary?

sami: rollback if p95 latency increases >20% sustained for 10m OR prompt-set quality regressions above threshold for 2 runs. cost spikes alone won't auto-rollback unless >40%.

ops-bot: canary checklist: enable perf probes, prompt-set evals, alerting, rollback hooks. playbook: https://internal.redwood/canary-playbook

olga: sample API snippet for docs: `POST /v1/orgs/{org}/routes/{route}/suggestions` body: `{ "action": "preview", "suggestion_id": "sugg-2850" }`

terry: owners/action items:
- olga: draft beta note + compatibility matrix by Tue
- ben: publish canary gating doc by Thu
- sami: update roadmap sheet and customer blurb by Fri

sami: thanks all — I'll close this thread once deliverables are linked. reply here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
